schema.description: ISA-95 MaterialClass: a group of material definitions that share properties. Abstract: a domain profile (e.g. SMProfile-ThermoplasticClass) declares which properties its classes carry. A material definition (Article) is DEFINED_BY its class; a class may INCLUDE_PROPERTIES_OF a broader class.

material_class_id.description: Identity of the material class (e.g. PA66-GF30).

parent_class_ref.description: The broader class whose properties this class includes (INCLUDES_PROPERTIES_OF).
